This deck is a very powerfull deck based around B-Wings.  I would appreciate it if you would rate this deck. thanks

== Strategy ==

Rebel Fleet allows me to cancel a force drain be playing a B-wing there and then I just play the B-wing straight from there.  I can coplete Kessel Run twice if necessary by using it followed by All Wings Report In.  With the Ralltiir Freighter Captain in the Queen's Royal Starship I can go straight to Kessel in one turn without having to stop inbetween.  Red Leader is usually deployed on the Home One so the opponent cant Cancel S-Foils.  We're Leaving is in to stop the opponent from getting a quick beat down.  Everything else is simple enough to understand.

Please rate this deck; thanks.
